stories.title: Azerbaijan GP Race Day — Russell on Pole, Antonelli Starts P15 After Q1 Crash

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
RACE DAY: Baku City Circuit 🏁

George Russell: pole position (1m42.526s — 0.8s clear of Leclerc)
Kimi Antonelli: P15 after crashing in Q1

Championship leader starting from the back. Title rival on pole.

This race matters. 🇦🇿 #AzerbaijanGP #F1

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli hit the wall at Turn 1 in Q1.

Broke his suspension. Out of qualifying entirely.

The championship leader starts somewhere around P15.

George Russell? Pole position.

Baku just got very interesting. #AzerbaijanGP #F1

article.headline: Russell Dominates Qualifying as Antonelli Crashes Out at Baku: Azerbaijan GP Race Day

stories.title: Antonelli at 19 — Historic Championship Lead, But Baku Tests the Cushion

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli. 19 years old. Leads the F1 world championship.

292 points. 8 wins. 6 poles. 15 podiums in 14 races.

Youngest championship leader in F1 history.

Even a bad day at Baku won't change that story. #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Antonelli's 81-point lead feels comfortable.

225 points remain this season.

If Russell wins Baku + Antonelli scores 0, gap drops to ~55 pts.

That's still a LOT. But it's a start.

Can Russell make it happen today? #AzerbaijanGP #F1

article.headline: At 19, Kimi Antonelli Is Rewriting F1 History — One Race at a Time
